music.prompt: Dark, sleek minimal bass house at exactly 124 BPM for a product comparison motion graphics film: mechanical keyboard clicks and typewriter ticks play the hi-hats, a tight punchy kick, a deep round rubbery bassline and short glassy synth stabs; focused and confident, no bright uplifting chords. No vocals. It starts immediately with keyboard-click hats and a muted kick (0 to 8 seconds, curious and slightly tense, no bass), rises with a filter sweep and a sub swell from 8 seconds, stops for one beat at 11.4 seconds, then drops at 11.9 seconds into the full groove with the rubbery bass and glassy stabs, which carries all the way to the end with extra percussion from 24 seconds. It ends cleanly on a downbeat at 40 seconds with no big final hit and no fade.
